params.prompt: A 1995 small-business homepage exactly as it looked in Netscape Navigator: flat grey (#C0C0C0) background, Times New Roman text, big centered heading «Добро пожаловать!», blue underlined links «Наши услуги | О нас | Контакты», a horizontal groove rule, a yellow-black striped «Сайт в разработке» construction banner with a tiny pixel-art worker GIF, a low-resolution clip-art picture, a table with thin bevelled borders, a black visitor counter with green digits «000137», an e-mail link with a little envelope icon. Naive, dated, low-res, 640px-era layout. Flat, straight-on full-page screenshot of the web page only: no browser window, no monitor, no device, no hands, no perspective, fills the whole frame edge to edge. Crisp and legible. No real brand logos, no watermark.
